284 of the council’s homes are fitted with Solar PV, with a further 8 homes having solar hot water. This is a total of 292 homes currently fitted with solar technology.

The council’s residential properties at Barnard’s Yard are also served by a River Water Source Heat Pump, serving 64 council and 18 private leasehold properties. This is a total of 93 council homes currently fitted with heat pump technology.

The council’s bid for the Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund includes a proposal to install Air Source Heat Pumps for 210 council homes, and a Ground Source Heat Pump system for 24 dwellings.
